concepts.name: 3d-01-nested-solids
concepts.title: 01 · 중첩 입체 모듈
concepts.prompt: Create ONE 16:9 high-end concept screenshot of DEPTH AI, an innovative FULLY THREE-DIMENSIONAL software module exploration environment. The user emphatically rejects flat node diagrams and flat maps merely viewed at an angle. The MODULES THEMSELVES MUST BE SOLID VOLUMETRIC OBJECTS, with real depth, occlusion, internal volume, varied heights, front/back faces and cast shadows. The camera is freely orbiting through a spatial assembly, shown in a strong oblique three-quarter perspective. The ENTIRE PROJECT is understandable through 8 to 12 distinct large subsystem assemblies, collectively containing hundreds of small 3D module bodies. Only the selected subsystem is exploded to expose individual modules; other systems remain compact and legible. Do NOT show 684 labels simultaneously. Parent-child membership is communicated by actual three-dimensional containment/assembly, not enclosing flat outlines. Visible connector sockets and a FEW routed physical-light links represent dependencies, never tangled wires. One shared module called Wallet has two incoming dependency paths from Reward and Shop. Highlight Reward and its relevant path in warm amber, everything else subdued. A small context panel at screen edge explains selected module: 'Reward', 'Purpose: puzzle success grants coins', 'Decision: isolate puzzle from economy', 'RewardPolicy.cs', '4 tests'. Reasons and source are metadata of this same module, not separate giant buildings. A compact live game preview with an explorer and +100 coin HUD occupies only 15% of image in one corner. A tiny navigation breadcrumb and orientation gizmo establish an interactive software tool, not an art installation. Large workspace, tiny brand 'DEPTH AI', subtle desktop chrome, exquisite legibility, professional materials and lighting. Main visible system labels can be Gameplay, Characters, Economy, World, UI, Network, Save, Audio. Any metrics are illustrative. Do NOT depict a literal real city, landscape islands, circuit board, glass card dashboard, infographic poster, or flat graph. Different structure below is mandatory. SHAPE DIRECTION 1: NESTED SOLIDS. Huge partially open translucent rounded polyhedral shells arranged in three dimensions at multiple depths. Each parent shell visibly contains dozens of small opaque ceramic rounded polyhedral module blocks, tightly organized with actual internal volume. Selected Economy shell has a quarter cut away; several interior modules slide outward on three axes in an exploded assembly while maintaining fine positional guides back to their homes. Reward is a warm amber solid chamfered module block in foreground, Wallet a single separate solid block nearby. Neighbouring subsystem shells behind and above remain intact, their contained blocks visible through subtle translucent sections. Large meaningful solid 3D forms, not labels on glass plates. Graphite studio background, pearl ceramic modules, smoked transparent parent shells, restrained cyan ports. Dramatic but usable perspective shows top, front and side of blocks. Very precise industrial design, no gratuitous reflections. Small label '01 / Nested volumes'.
